blocks.task_summary: Sketch the graph of y = |f(x)|, clearly indicating any asymptotes.
method_path: Identify original graph features: local max A(-1/2, 5/2), local min B(0, -15/2), vertical asymptote x = -1/2, oblique asymptote y = 5x + 5.
Apply absolute value: reflect negative parts of f(x) across x-axis.
Sketch right branch: minimum in approximately correct position, asymptotic to y = 5x + 5.
Sketch left branch: reflect original left branch (which was below x-axis) across x-axis, so minimum becomes positive, asymptotic to x = -1/2.
Draw new oblique asymptote y = -5x - 5 for left branch (reflected).

evidence.basis: right branch with minimum in approximately correct position AND showing asymptotic behaviour to y = 5x + 5 (A1); asymptotic behaviour on both branches at x = -1/2 (A1); left branch reflected in x-axis with minimum in approximately correct position (M1); oblique asymptote (y = -5x - 5) drawn in approximately correct position AND left branch with correct asymptotic behaviour (A1)

blocks.task_summary: Sketch the graph of y = 15/f(x), clearly indicating any asymptotes and intercepts with the axes.
method_path: Identify original graph features: local max A(-1/2, 5/2), local min B(0, -15/2), vertical asymptote x = -1/2, oblique asymptote y = 5x + 5.
Determine intercepts: when f(x) = 15, y = 1; when f(x) = -15, y = -1. Use original graph to estimate x-intercepts of new function.
Determine asymptotes: vertical asymptote remains x = -1/2; horizontal asymptote y = 0 as |f(x)| → ∞.
Sketch: axes intercepts in approximately correct positions (A1); local extrema in approximately correct positions (A1); asymptotic behavior to y = 0 on both sides (A1).

evidence.basis: axes intercepts in approximately correct positions (A1); local extrema in approximately correct positions (A1); asymptotic behavior to y = 0 on both sides OR asymptote at y = 0 indicated on sketch (A1)
